fields.label: Data Policy ID
fields.help: User-assigned (human readable) ID of the data policy that needs to be unique within a project.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Etag
fields.help: The etag for this Data Policy.

fields.label: Grantees
fields.help: The list of IAM principals that have Fine Grained Access to the underlying data goverened by this data policy.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Data Governance Tag
Value
fields.help: Tag value is expected to be the short name.
Data Governance tag bound to the Data Policy.

fields.label: Data Masking Policy
Routine
fields.help: The name of the BigQuery routine that contains the custom masking routine, in the format of 'projects/{project_number}/datasets/{dataset_id}/routines/{routine_id}'.
The policy used to specify data masking rule.
